name: THE BEST INVESTOR
detailed_description:
Welcome to THE BEST INVESTOR — the strategic board game where having money is just the beginning. The real challenge? Knowing how to grow it.

You start the game with $5 million. Your mission: build a financial empire through smart investments, clever negotiations, and bold decisions. Face off against up to 5 other players locally or challenge advanced A.I. opponents in solo mode. Every turn can shift the balance. Will you rise to the top — or lose it all?

Invest in stocks, gold, cities, and banking systems to generate passive income — but beware of bad moves. Every action has consequences in this fast-paced financial simulation.

💼 A Smart, Fun, and Strategic Investment Game

  • 🌍 Explore real-world cities and invest in local businesses.

  • 📈 Buy shares, collect dividends every minute, and sell when the time is right.

  • 🪙 Trade in gold — high risk, high reward.

  • 🏦 Manage multiple bank accounts, transfer funds, but beware of bankruptcies!

  • 🔁 Negotiate with other players — buy or sell cities and assets to gain the upper hand.

  • 🧠 Craft your own investment strategy: aggressive, conservative, or somewhere in between.

🎓 Financial Education Meets Entertainment

THE BEST INVESTOR is more than a game — it’s a fun and approachable simulation of financial portfolio management. Learn by playing and boost your geographical knowledge as you explore cities around the globe. It’s the perfect blend of education and entertainment.

👥 Local Multiplayer or Solo Against Bots

  • Up to 6 players on the same screen

  • Solo mode against smart A.I. opponents

⚙️ Deep and Dynamic Gameplay

  • Take 2 actions per turn (except on Start and Tax spaces)

  • Earn passive income every minute from your stock holdings

  • Strategic tax zones force you to plan profit-taking wisely

  • Interconnected stock and gold markets create endless opportunities

Will you protect and grow your wealth — or lose it all in one bad move?
Being rich is one thing... Becoming THE BEST INVESTOR is another.

supported_languages:
English*, French, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo 2.4Ghz or Higher / AMD 3Ghz or Higher
  • Graphics: Integrated
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10 64bits
  • Processor: intel core i3 4th generation or later
  • Graphics: Integrated
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: screen resolution in : 16/9 is better
